08:45 Local Time, 06:45 GMT, 12:15 IST: Hello and welcome to our coverage of the third and final ODI of this series between Zimbabwe and Australia. The visiting Australian side has already sealed the series 2-0, winning both matches by a comfortable margin. It was Renshaw's ton in the first match, and Head's in the second, that allowed them to post formidable totals after batting first (or being put into bat first). In contrast, none of the Zimbabwe batters have made it to three figures, something that captain Sikandar Raza is mindful of. In fact, in the previous match, every single batter in Zimbabwe's top six made it past 20, but none of them could even get to a half-century. It's an area the hosts would like to improve on - how to build more substantial partnerships.

For Australia, this is a good workout in conditions that might be similar in the World Cup next year. They rotated their quicks in the first couple of matches, and might make some changes again today - one of them will be a forced one with Billy Stanlake injured.
